title: security(rbac): enforce RBAC v2 KMS region-pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Asha Ramaswamy
release_notes: Enforce KMS region residency constraints and harden RBAC v2 audit logging. Adds configuration toggles for gradual rollout and migration guide. No public API breaking changes.
description:
Background: customers operating under EU/UK data residency requirements and corporate KMS policies need stronger guardrails to ensure keys and encrypted artifacts never leave approved regions. This PR closes multiple gaps in the RBAC v2 policy engine and audit pipeline: 1) enforce KMS region-pinning at policy-evaluation time, 2) emit richer audit events when KMS selections are overridden or unavailable, and 3) harden admin APIs to prevent silent fallbacks to global keys.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds region-residency check to the RBAC v2 policy evaluator; requests that reference KMS key metadata are rejected when the requested region is disallowed by the owning resource policy (configurable allowlist/denylist).
- Augments audit logging with structured fields: kms_key_id, kms_region, policy_decision, decision_reason, and fallback_attempt. Audit events are now written to the existing audit-log stream and to the KMS-specific audit index for easier query.
- Introduces a feature-flagged rollout path (feature.rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning) that defaults to audit-only mode for 2 weeks; once enabled, failures become enforcement mode.
- Adds a migration utility to backfill KMS metadata for existing resources to support deterministic policy decisions.
- Updates docs and the operator runbook: includes checklist for enabling enforcement, necessary IAM roles, and mitigations for cross-region key scenarios.

Why: prior incidents showed that in low-capacity scenarios the serving runtime fell back to a global KMS key, which violated customer residency constraints. We also had insufficient audit fields to detect when this happened. This change reduces blast radius and provides clear observability for security teams.

Testing and validation: unit tests for policy evaluator (coverage for allow/deny list and unknown-region), integration tests that simulate KMS unavailability and verify audit events, end-to-end tests in staging with the feature flag toggled. Performance: evaluator adds a single KMS metadata lookup (cached) — measured median policy evaluation latency increase < 1ms on CI perf runs.

Rollout plan:
1) Enable feature.rbac_v2.kms_region_pinning in audit-only mode in staging and run smoke tests for 48h.
2) Deploy to canary customer clusters with enforcement disabled; verify audit stream and backfill results.
3) After 2 weeks of metrics validation (no unexpected rejects), flip to enforcement in non-critical regions.
4) Gradually enable for customers with explicit region policies; ops runbook included for emergency rollback.

Checklist: [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] docs updated [x] migration utility included [x] runbook updated

Notes: this PR is intentionally conservative — enforcement is gated by feature flag and requires metadata backfill. Operators should follow migration steps before flipping enforcement to true.
